persona.context: responsible for reducing employee turnover and improving employee retention
constraints: can take actions on no more than 10 employees per month

suggested.why_this_data_supports_it: is_terminated supplies the outcome, while hire_date, department, salary, and satisfaction_score supply dated predictors
required_first: build point-in-time snapshots that exclude termination_date after each scoring cutoff
suggested.business_action: recommend interventions for up to 10 at-risk employees per month to the HR Manager
suggested.fits_the_constraint: outputs a ranked top-10 list rather than a score for every employee

declined.intent: predict employee churn without dated outcome snapshots
declined.reason: the current rows cannot separate facts known at scoring time from later termination outcomes
